name: obsidian-one-click-publish
description: One-click publishing for active Obsidian Markdown notes through your Cloudflare Worker.
author: Jin Hefeng

scripts.cf:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.cf:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.cf:provisioner:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply publish-note-provisioning --local --config wrangler.provisioner.jsonc
scripts.cf:provisioner:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply publish-note-provisioning --remote --config wrangler.provisioner.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run cf:migrate:remote && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.update:plugin: npm run build:plugin && npm run package:plugin && npm run check:plugin && npm run sync:plugin

DB.description: D1 database for account, token, upload, site metadata, and personal-deployment content chunks.

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: One-time secret used at /setup to create the first self-hosted account.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Optional public URL used when generating /s/{siteId} links; leave empty to use the Worker URL.
